title: Subhomogeneous Character-Free Subalgebras of Infinite Tensor Powers
exact_target: Let $B$ be a separable unital $C^*$-algebra without characters and with separating tracial states. Does $B\otimes_{\min}B\otimes_{\min}\cdots$ contain a subhomogeneous $C^*$-algebra without characters?
